notes.title: Update 14.0: HUGE Update + 15 Items + 10 Achievements + QOL + Balancing and more
notes.notes:
[p][b]Update 14.0 : HUGE Update + 10 Items + 10 Achievements + New Enemy + QOL + Balancing (September 23 2025)

Here are the main goals of this HUGE 14.0 update:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Make every stat meaningful[/b]: complete rework of Range, Cooldown, and Knockback stats.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Make every item impactful[/b]: many items now have unique effects, and stat-boosting items give much bigger increments. White-tier items also offer more interesting choices.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fewer but stronger drops[/b]: players now get slightly fewer items during a run, but each one has a much stronger impact.[/p][/*][*][p][b]15 new items + major reworks[/b]: 15 brand-new items, numerous reworks, and a few removals of less interesting items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Raise the challenge in D5[/b]: tighter balancing to keep the game challenging at Difficulty 5 [/p][/*][*][p][b]New achievements[/b]: all remaining “Win a Run with X Character in D5” achievements are implemented (retroactively unlocked at first launch of 14.0+ if already completed)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Extensive balancing[/b]: a pass across attacks, items, and difficulty curves[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quality-of-life improvements[/b]: small changes to make the game smoother[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better looking UI[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Noobs Are Coming has always shined through its [b]huge playstyle diversity[/b], with [b]35 playable characters with unique effects[/b] and [b]70+ silly attacks with their own features[/b]. And now thanks to this update, the Items are also a super interesting aspect of the game.[/p][p]Also I’m super happy to announce that [b]Valve has officially added [i]Noobs Are Coming[/i] to the[/b] [b]“Steam Deck Verified ✅”[/b] catalog. It feels quite surreal to see my game listed in such a prestigious catalog![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438421/ef4ac13744deb8b1ab567026087c0c9c757feaba.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Here is the changelog, keep in mind this list is [b]FAR from exhaustive[/b]. Almost every single item in the game has been reworked, with many receiving significant buffs. Players will now find slightly fewer items during a run, but each one has a [b]much stronger impact[/b].

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]15 NEW ITEMS[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Enemy Type:[/b] Elite Animated Armor spawing Damaging Areas around the player[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Venom:[/b] each time you’re doing an crit hit on an enemy, there is a chance to poison it doing Dots Dex Damage[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Specialist[/b] (red item); you can only find Attacks you already have equipped[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Banker’s Heart[/b] (blue item): extra HP Max based on your current Souls count[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Orb Vacuum[/b] (green item): attracts your Skill Orbs[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Potion Detox[/b] (blue item); convert 100% of your Heal from Potions stat to Luck (1 Heal from Potion => 4 Luck)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Whispers[/b] (white item), 10% chance to heal 1 HP when picking up a soul[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Fortress[/b] (blue, more armor while standing still)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Spit[/b] (white, slowdown enemies when you hit them)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Polyspecialist[/b] (purple item)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Learning Curve[/b] (green item)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Necromancy[/b] (blue item)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Liar[/b] (purple)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Critical Eye[/b] (purple)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Grand Cru[/b] (purple)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item: Long Arm[/b] (green)[/p][/*][*][p][b]10 New Achievements:[/b] all remaining “Win a run with this character in D5” are now implemented (Belzebuth, Nosferastik, Scrollmancer, Killer of Demon Hunter, Boomperor, Cat, Belzebuth, Magnebro, Mr Glitch, Longnek, Behemoth)[/p][/*][*][p]Those achievements are retroactively unlocked the first time you launch the game in version 14.0+ if you already completed them in previous versions[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]ENHANCEMENTS:[/b][/p][list][*][p]QOL: On the title screen and on the progress screen, the current completion of achievements is displayed (ex: “84/113”)[/p][/*][*][p]Full rework of the Knockback Stat[/p][/*][*][p]Full rework of the Cooldown Stat (and it is now Attack Speed)[/p][/*][*][p]Full rework of the Range Stat[/p][/*][*][p]Completely changed the effects of tons of items, the goal is to make every single item in the game feel meaningful[/p][/*][*][p]Change the name/icon of some existing items[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the balancing of many characters and attacks (especially since 3 main stats were fully reworked)[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced many waves[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visual of the icons[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a few items that weren’t super interesting in their current implementation[/p][/*][*][p]New Stat: Damage against Elites[/p][/*][*][p]Many Skills (Impact/Wrecking Ball/Dash now have Bonus Damage against Elites, which should make skill more viable for end runs[/p][/*][*][p]Removed XP Gain Stat Upgrades from the Level Up Upgrades to avoid too much dilution of the available choices when you Level Up [/p][/*][*][p]DoTs Attack (Poison Dagger, Torch, Bow) are now more powerful[/p][/*][*][p]Ballista: now even Tier 0 has piercing[/p][/*][*][p]Wrecking Ball: provide +10% Speed[/p][/*][*][p]Whip: 100% Minion Damage => 60% Minion Damage, 60% Strength Damage[/p][/*][*][p]Pentagram: while inside the circle: +20% Damage => -20% Cooldown[/p][/*][*][p]Shovel Attack: Max Trigger per Animation for the Soul Spawning 1 => 1/2/2/3[/p][/*][*][p]RNGesus: +100 Luck -25% Cooldown => +80 Luck -20% Cooldown[/p][/*][*][p]Centilegs Character Rework [/p][/*][*][p]Removed the vortex animation during the Level Upgrade phase for now[/p][/*][*][p]Pyromaniac Item Full Rework: each time you hit an item there is a change to burn it doing Dots Elem Damage[/p][/*][*][p]Boomperor: explosion scales with 200% Amount => 400% Amount[/p][/*][*][p]Boomperor: init attack slot: 2 => 3[/p][/*][*][p]QOL: the description of effects of many items/characters are now more concise and compact[/p][/*][*][p]QOL: the separator line of some tooltip is now more subtle[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous balancing tweaks following recent major changes (items, attacks, enemies, waves, and core formulas) (14.3)[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: Paloof heroic boss fight not appearing (14.3)[/p][/*][*][p]Massively improved sound design (14.3)[/p][/*][*][p]Removed SFX from many base enemies (to avoid unpleasant noise when lots are on-screen) (14.3)[/p][/*][*][p]Only Elites and Bosses now have SFX (14.3)[/p][/*][*][p]DoT attacks like Poison and Burn are now much quieter, etc. (14.3)[/p][/*][*][p]Void Hammer rework: now deals Arcane chain damage (14.3)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Explosions visual effects to better match the actual hitbox (14.3)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the UI style in different places (14.5)[/p][/*][*][p]Attacks tier colors: white/blue/green/purple => green/blue/purple/red (14.5)[/p][/*][*][p]Next Wave indication in Level Upgrade/Chest Found/Shop phases now also indicates the current Difficulty (14.5)[/p][/*][*][p]Axe and Fragile Hammer attacks are now more powerful (14.5)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the description of the new Skill Vacuum item so it’s clear it’s attracting the Activation Orb of your Skill Attacks (14.5)[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Update 14.2 :[/b] Minor Balancing tweaks and improvements[b] (September 23 2025)[/b][/p][p][b]Update 14.3 / 14.4 : [/b]Balancing + Paloof Bossfight + Massively improved SFX + Void Hammer Rework [b](September 24 2025)[/b][/p][p][b]Update 14.5 :[/b] Enhancements [b](September 25 2025)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you!

[b]Enjoy![/b][/p]

notes.title: Update 13.0: Skip Cutscenes + Attack Reworks + Balancing + Enhancements
notes.notes:
[p][b]Update 13.0 : Skip Cutscenes + Attack Reworks + Balancing + Enhancements (September 18 2025)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]For the third day in a row, here’s another major update. This one is packed with [b]tons of balancing changes [/b]inspired by feedback from awesome players on the Game Discord! Almost every attack has been reworked, and many items have been adjusted.
One of the main goals of this update is to ensure that [b]every stat feels meaningful[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]For example, [b]Cooldown, Range, and Speed now play a bigger role[/b], creating a [b]much more engaging combat feel[/b] and [b]giving a stronger sense of progression during each run[/b]. These changes should also improve the game’s overall difficulty balance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]HP regeneration[/b] has been made a bit harder to obtain as it seemed too easy to reach high HP/sec in recent versions. (It should make Potion Heal, Life Steal, Armor and Dodge more interesting to pick again)[/p][/*][/list][p]This update also introduces the [b]highly requested option to skip cutscenes[/b], brings [b]Shop UI improvements[/b], and includes important [b]reworks for many attacks[/b].[/p][p]
(Here are the changelogs from the two big updates published in the past two days in case you missed them:)[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2225960/announcements/detail/535487694763982958"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2225960/announcements/detail/553501640235156625"][/dynamiclink][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Changelog of today's 13.0 Update: (September 18 2025)[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]NEW QOL FEATURE: Skip Cutscenes option[/b][/p][/*][*][p]QOL: When you buy an item you already have equipped, its icon is moved to the start of your inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]QOL: Stat Upgrades you buy when you level up aren’t displayed in the inventory anymore (it makes the UI looks much better and the inventory much more readable)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overdisk Attack Rework:[/b] now attract nearby enemies towards its center and does damage per tick[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lazerdin Attack Rework:[/b] the lazer now bounce of wall based on the Bounce Stat[/p][/*][*][p][b]Changed the balancing of almost every Attack in the game[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the Default Range of many attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the Default Cooldown duration of many attacks (lower attack speed by default)[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced the default Speed of the Player[/p][/*][*][p]Rogue Enemies are now a bit slower to compensate[/p][/*][*][p]Cheater Item/Mr Glitch: the effect that allow unique items & limited items at full stack to be found again was happening too rarely, the chance to find a unique item for the second time is still a bit lower than usual but much higher than it was before[/p][/*][*][p]Cloud Attack: reduced the range of the chain lightning[/p][/*][*][p]Sheepify Wand: removed the Life Steal[/p][/*][*][p]Wand: scale with Amount[/p][/*][*][p]Lightning Dagger: Lightning Chain now triggers maximum 1 time per attack[/p][/*][*][p]Totem: projectiles now pierce 1 time[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the volume of the Golden Soul SFX[/p][/*][*][p]HP Regen Level Up Upgrades: 2/3/4/5 => 1/2/3/4[/p][/*][*][p]HP Regen Stat: is now capped to 50 [/p][/*][*][p]Holy Hit Item: now has 30% chance to heal on Critical Hit, and this effect has a limit of 2 HP retrieved per sec, that prevent it to trigger too often because it was too overpowered[/p][/*][*][p]Regen Amulet Item: Limited to 3 => Limited to 2[/p][/*][*][p]Cookie => Limited to 5[/p][/*][*][p]Many Eyes => Limited to 2[/p][/*][*][p]Vicious => Limited to 6[/p][/*][*][p]Glass Heart: white item => green item[/p][/*][*][p]Heart Earrings: green item => white item[/p][/*][*][p]Pierced Skull: now -1 Damage Arcane and -1 Damage Elem[/p][/*][*][p]Many other minor balancing changes on Items[/p][/*][*][p]Minotaur Character: +30% Speed and +1 Str Damage/3% Speed => +25% Speed and +1 Str Damage/4% Speed[/p][/*][*][p]Minotaur Character: now has a -30 Range Malus[/p][/*][*][p]Nosferastik Character: HP Regen Modifications are now decreased by 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Monoculus Character: +100% Damage and -30% Cooldown => +80% Damage and -20% Cooldown[/p][/*][*][p]Some other general minor balancing changes[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Update 13.2: (September 18 2025)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rebalanced some waves in some difficulties that became too hard in 13.0[/p][/*][*][p]Elite Enemies now have more HP[/p][/*][*][p]TNT Block dropped by Explosive Enemy and Nighmare Boss now slowly moves towards you[/p][/*][*][p]Minion Synergy (2) => +8% Player Speed[/p][/*][*][p]Skull Planter Item => removed the +3% Enemy HP[/p][/*][*][p]Mutation Item: removed the -1 Heal from Potion [/p][/*][*][p]Hood Item: 2% Dodge => 4% Dodge[/p][/*][*][p]Double Shadow Item:  2% Dodge => 4% Dodge[/p][/*][*][p]Changed balancing of some Attackls (Goldenator, Lazerdin, Shotgun, Ballista)[/p][/*][*][p]Pickaxe: sweep animation was too fast[/p][/*][*][p]Dash Skill: slightly reduced the dash duration and speed[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of other minor changes [/p][/*][*][p]Improved some translations[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Update 13.3 & 13.4 (September 19 2025)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tons of minor balancing tweaks to try to adjust the difficulty as it became too hard as an indirect consequences of other important balancing tweaks in 13.0[/p][/*][*][p](this Stat Mechanic Rework: sell value of your attacks and items not picked in chest is now a bit higher, and there is a dynamic system that prevent this to be exploited in extreme situations[/p][/*][*][p]Sell Value now has a description in its tooltip from the Stat List, also it is now clear it also affects the sell value of the Item you don’t pick in +10% Pickup Range => +20% Pickup Range[/p][/*][*][p]Leeching Worm: -2 HP Max => -1 HP Max[/p][/*][*][p]Skull Planter: white item => green item[/p][/*][*][p]Stone Block: blue item => green item[/p][/*][*][p]Straw Hat: 2% Soul Harvest => 3% Soul Harvest[/p][/*][*][p]Juggler: Limited to 2 => to 3[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of minor change to the balancing of some items and attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: Soul Portal: during the subtle period when you can still pickup souls even if they’re slurped by the portal, the player could sometimes benefits from the “x2 souls” that should only happen for next wave[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: Whip Attack + fast Attack Orbit Speed had a subtle attack hitbox accuracy issue[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: Monoculus Character + Heart Earrings Item + Amputation Item: gave -2 HP Max instead of doing nothing[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Once again, thanks to everyone for playing the game!     [/b]
[/p][p]If you’re enjoying the game and want to support my passionate work as a tiny solodev without a big publisher, 
[b]please consider leaving a[/b] [b]positive review on Steam[/b] ✨   

If you’d like to provide feedback on the game, please join our Discord and post it there. It’s the process we’ve been using with the community to [b]deliver 100+ updates based on players feedback[/b] since the first private beta.  [url="https://discord.com/invite/wMK34Z3RMU"]DISCORD[/url]
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225960/Noobs_Are_Coming/"][/dynamiclink][b]Enjoy![/b][/p]

notes.title: Update 12.0: New Bossfight + Many Enhancements
notes.notes:
[p][b]Update 12.0 : NEW BOSSFIGHT + VARIOUS ENHANCEMENTS (September 17 2025)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]After the big update from yesterday, here is already another update, with a new Bossfight (Paloof Heroic Noob) and many enhancements[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog of the big 11.0 update published yesterday (in case you missed it):[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2225960/view/553501640235156624"][/dynamiclink]
[b]Changelog of today's 12.0 Update:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New Heroic Enemy:[/b] Paloof (Bossfight at wave 15/20/25)[/p][/*][*][p]Armored Horned Warrior Elite Rework: now shoots projectiles in the direction they’re dashing and behind[/p][/*][*][p]Rework the “Soul Steal” Mechanic used by Goldenator and Shovel attack: the tooltip are now more compact, and this effect can now only triggers once “per shot”.
example: Shovel has 20% to spawn an soul on hit, each time it hits an enemy in a single attack animation, it throw the dice but it can only trigger the effect once during an animation (Same, for for Goldenator, each bullet can spawn a maximum of 1 golden soul).[/p][/*][*][p]Dash Skill Full Rework: better gamefeel, better hitbox, now also apply half of its damage as a shockwave that also deal knockback[/p][/*][*][p]Potion Cork + Collectors Aura Combo Enhancement: health potion aren’t attracted anymore if they can’t be drunk (this way they don’t stack anymore)[/p][/*][*][p]Pickaxe: doesn’t destroy after X Wave anymore[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Lazerdin Attack: scales with 100% Dex Damage => scales with 60% Dex Damage and 60% Arcane Damage[/p][/*][*][p]Lazerdin Synergies: “Golden” tag was a mistake => now “Void” instead[/p][/*][*][p]Twin Attack: now a Unique attack[/p][/*][*][p]Fire Bow Attack: base damage now scales with Elemental instead of Dexterity[/p][/*][*][p]Overboy Playable Character: now requires to unlock 25 characters instead of 30[/p][/*][*][p]Golden Hammer: the sweeping attack animation was too fast [/p][/*][*][p]Golden Hammer: turning an enemy into a gold statue can now only happen max 1 time per Sweeping Attack Animation[/p][/*][*][p]Void Hammer: now scales both with Strength Damage and Arcane Damage[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of little balancing changes on many attacks (such as Pistol, Void Hammer, Golden Hammer, Shovel, Goldenator, Pickaxe and many more)[/p][/*][*][p]Changed/Added some synergies on some attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Changed some synergy effects and names[/p][/*][*][p]Centilegs: now has 10 procedurally animated legs instead of 6[/p][/*][*][p]Minotaur Character: +1 Strength Damage per 2% Speed => +1 per 3% Speed[/p][/*][*][p]RNGesus Character: removed the effect boosting Luck upgrades, as +100 Luck by default is already super powerful (and it was resulting in a weird +125 Luck by default which was a bit confusing)[/p][/*][*][p]Pandark Character: can now start with Dash Skill[/p][/*][*][p]Many other minor changes[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: “Enemy Killed This Wave” and “Damage Dealt this Wave” on attack tooltips were wrong due to a typo[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: due to this same typo, effects that should trigger on Enemy Killed triggered in situations were it shouldn’t (example: Midas was turning too many enemies into Gold Statues)[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: Laser Eye Attack: during the first frame the laser appear, it had a subtle angle offset[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: Potion Cork + Collector’s Aura could prevent to pick some pickups in specific situations when HP were Full[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Once again, thanks to everyone for playing the game!

  [/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225960/Noobs_Are_Coming/"][/dynamiclink][b]
Enjoy![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.0: Mid-run Save/Resume + Shop RNG Rework + Enhancements + Balancing

[p][b]This is a BIG update packed with improvements, including two of the most requested features: Mid-run Autosave & Resume, and a rework of the Shop RNG for Attacks![/b][/p][p]Since the game launched just a few days ago, these have been among the top requests—right after Visibility Options, which were added in Update 3.0 and further improved in this 5.0 update.[/p][p]Implementing Mid-run Autosave & Resume was a complex and challenging task, requiring careful handling of many edge cases. But I'm super happy to say it's finally in the game! :D[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW FEATURES:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]NEW MAJOR FEATURE:[/b] Mid-run Autosave and Resume Run (so you can go back to Title Screen or even close the app and still resume your run, note that you can only resume a run from the same game version)[/p][/*][*][p][b]SHOP RNG for Attacks:[/b] Big rework and enhancements, there was already tons of systems under the hood to favorize similar Attacks to appear (while still allowing discoverability to be able to go very creative and create unique builds), but I improved them even more, and the shop should provide you related Attacks (same tags/synergies or same Damage Scaling more often)[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW ITEM: Kickception:[/b] your Kickables can kick other kickables[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW ITEM: Discord:[/b] 1% chance to charm a Noob when it spawns [i](5.3)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Chained Ball Attack: can now kick other kickables by default

[h3]Thank you everyooone![/h3][p]
Since it's the very first Steam news since launch, I want to thank you all for playing Noobs Are Coming and for the overwhelmingly positive reception in your messages! [/p][p][b]Many of you have been leaving great positive reviews for the game[/b], and given how important that is, I truly appreciate it. If you haven’t yet, please consider leaving one, it can definitely make a huge difference![/p][p][/p][p]The game sold more than [b]5 000 COPIES IN JUST 1 DAY!!![/b] [/p][p]Completely crazy, it far exceeded my expectations and all the typical data about what a game is expected to do based on its wishlist count before launch.[/p][p][/p][p]I want to give a special thanks to [b]Thomas and Marco from Blobfish Games (creators of [i]Brotato[/i])[/b]. As you know, Brotato was the main inspiration for Noobs Are Coming (it’s one of the best games ever made) and t[b]hey were kind enough to feature Noobs Are Coming on Brotato’s Steam page and Discord[/b]. We’re also part of [b]a cool "Complete the Set" bundle with Brotato.[/b][/p][h3]
What's next?[/h3][p]I'm currently processing all the feedback people have sent on Discord and the Steam forums to determine what the priorities should be for upcoming updates. Thank you all so much for your detailed reports, ideas, and suggestions—this is exactly how I want to improve the game: directly based on your feedback. It’s a super fun process for me![/p][p]One of the first big features I plan to implement is [b]autosave during runs[/b], so you can resume even if you need to close the app—whether for life stuff or issues. (It’s a pretty big and complex feature to implement, but I think it’s both really cool and important.)[/p][p]Another priority will be [b]adding new accessibility and visibility options[/b]. Since the game allows for completely crazy builds, the action can sometimes become a bit chaotic, which is incredibly fut, but having some options to make things clearer in those situations would be super cool![/p][p]For now, [strike]my top priority is fixing some issues affecting about 1–2% of users (app sometimes failing to launch)[/strike] [b]\[FIXED][/b]. I also have a lot to handle regarding the game’s release itself, but I’ll do my best to keep making changes and enhancements to the game—I'm having so much fun working on it! 😄 [/p][h3]PATCH NOTES of the first quick updates[/h3][p]For the next few updates, I’ll keep updating this post with any changes to the game (enhancements, balancing, new features, and gameplay bug fixes), as it will probably be quick updates for now.[/p][p]If you notice a tiny Steam update that doesn’t seem to change anything (no dedicated patch note below/no version number bump), it likely means I’m experimenting with potential fixes for very rare bugs and communicating with players to make sur it works before writing a patch note.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Early Access -
